title: dev-team engine answer
description: The one shape every engine command prints on standard output, so other programs can read it.

engine.description: Which engine and which command produced this answer.

command.description: The command that was run (empty when none was given).

ok.description: True only when the command finished with exit code 0.

result.description: The command's answer. Its shape depends on the command; null when the command failed.

problems.description: Why the command was not OK. Empty when it was.

code.description: A short stable name for the problem, such as BAD_INPUT or SCHEMA.
